scope: Fixed saved 195D counted denominator and saved two-vector M8 numerator; initial time-first purification followed by its canonical [8,16] signed-transfer window at beta=2*initial_beta.
consequence: On beta<=12, transported P=a^2*b<5/8. The ideal first-window purity is (sqrt(2P-1)+(2P-1))/2<=3/8 when P>1/2, otherwise its domain fails. On beta>=12, z<1/2 implies b<1/2 and P<1/2. Thus the fixed recipe cannot certify its first [8,16] window at any beta. This limits recipe outputs, not physical ratios.
